name: Exp_BlauSMStochastic
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauSMStochastic custom indicator, which is a smoothed stochastic momentum indicator by William Blau. It supports three trading modes: zero-line breakdown, histogram twist, and cloud twist of the indicator buffers, opening buy/sell positions and closing opposite ones accordingly.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauSMStochastic自定义指标进行交易，这是William Blau的平滑随机动量指标。支持三种交易模式：零线突破、直方图扭转折转和指标云图扭转折转，据此开仓买入/卖出并平掉反向仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Blau的平滑随机动量指标(BlauSMStochastic)，该指标对传统随机指标进行多重平滑处理以减少噪音。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时开仓，twist模式在直方图方向扭转折转时开仓，cloudtwist模式在上下云线交叉时开仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式。资金管理采用固定比例或固定手数方式，但缺少动态调整和加仓逻辑。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖单一指标且缺乏过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Blau's Smoothed Stochastic Momentum indicator (BlauSMStochastic), which applies multiple smoothing passes to the traditional stochastic to reduce noise. Entry conditions come in three modes: breakdown mode opens positions when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters on histogram direction reversal, and cloudtwist mode enters when the upper and lower cloud lines cross. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels applied. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes for lot calculation. Money management uses a fixed ratio or fixed lot approach but lacks dynamic adjustment or pyramiding logic. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies on a single indicator with no additional filtering mechanism.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

pros: 三种交易模式提供灵活性，适应不同市场状态
使用多重平滑的随机动量指标，有效减少虚假信号
具备独立的买入/卖出开平仓开关，可精细控制交易方向
设置了固定止损止盈，有基本的风险控制框架
新K线检测机制避免同一K线重复交易
pros_en: Three trading modes provide flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Multi-smoothed stochastic momentum indicator effectively reduces false signals
Independent buy/sell open/close switches allow fine-grained control over trading direction
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide a basic risk control framework
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same bar
cons: 完全依赖单一指标，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能在多数品种上不合理
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时仍会开仓
缺少移动止损或追踪止盈机制，无法锁定浮动利润
未检测是否已有同向持仓，可能重复开仓
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering
Default StopLoss of 1000 and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
No spread filter — trades can open even when spread is wide
Lacks trailing stop or trailing take-profit mechanism to lock in floating profits
Does not check for existing same-direction positions, potentially opening duplicate trades
improvements: 增加多指标确认过滤，如加入趋势方向或波动率过滤条件
添加点差过滤和持仓检查，避免高成本重复开仓
引入动态止损止盈或追踪止损机制，提高盈利保护能力
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation filters such as trend direction or volatility conditions
Implement spread filtering and position checking to avoid high-cost duplicate entries
Introduce dynamic stop loss/take profit or trailing stop mechanisms to better protect profits

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致重复开仓，增加风险敞口
默认止损止盈点数过大，若未根据品种调整可能造成巨额亏损或错过合理出场
无点差过滤在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损交易
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate entries, increasing risk exposure
Default SL/TP values are very large and may cause significant losses if not adjusted per instrument
No spread filter can lead to unnecessary losing trades in high-spread environments

It supports three trading modes: zero-line breakdown, histogram twist, and cloud twist of the indicator buffers, opening buy/sell positions and closing opposite ones accordingly.
